notes.title: Update 1.03 out!
notes.content:
Hello friends!

We have here a new update, not much content yet, but they will be more frequent in future.

The town is a little different now, there is more free space for future builds, there is a town hall in the center, that will be available soon!

Grameria east is available now, there is alot of rats there, go hunter them!

A new UI: diary. that will show about how are you relationship with npcs, factions, and with the gods, and much more! (still under development!)

Grameria West and more, in next 1-2 weeks!

3 different sizes of rats. bigger, stronger.
little rat is weaker now, was 20 hp to only 5, you can kill it with 5 hit bare hand, or with 2 hit with a stick.

bye!

notes.title: Alpha 1.01 out and About next upcoming features!
notes.content:
UI Fixes:

Putting a towel in bathtub didn't show the correct information
Fix getting a empty item if consume all the item while using toilet or bathtub

------

Added a UI showing commands
Bar have now 5 beer not 2
Bar have now chocolate 
Fiber(grass) can be sell for 2 copper coins not 1
Mine ore can drop a expensive gemstone
Mine stone is more common to get salt rock
All skill need a lot less spiria points and aura points to lern
Food and drinks give 25% more aura points
World Map UI Rework
Energy recovers 33% faster
Run spends 33% less energy


Future features:

Next to town you can buy this house with fences, make upgrades on furniture like improving your bedroom and your bathroom.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33459698/c149868d23f5fa236ad20073845c8eab56e7b6bb.png[/img]
you can build a stable for your mounts like: horse, camel and an elephant. Each mount has its advantages and disadvantages. you need to feed them by filling the box with food, and caring for them.

you can build a chicken coop and have up to 4 chickens, you also need to feed them by filling the food box and giving affection.

This features and much more in the next updates.
See you later!
